elements_selected.content: Create crates/spindle-core/src/arith.rs with: ArithExpr enum (Lit, Var, NaryOp, BinOp, UnaryOp), NaryArithOp (Add, Sub, Mul, Div, Min, Max), BinArithOp (IDiv, Rem, Pow), UnaryArithOp (Abs), CmpOp (Eq, Ne, Lt, Gt, Le, Ge), ArithConstraint (Bind{var, expr}, Compare{op, lhs, rhs}), ArithError enum (DivisionByZero, IntegerOverflow, DecimalOverflow, UnboundVariable, TypeMismatch, NonFiniteFloat, ReciprocalOfZero, ComparisonFailed). Implement ArithExpr::eval(&self, subst: &Substitution) -> Result<NumericValue, ArithError> with: checked integer arithmetic, rust_decimal for decimal ops, f64 for float ops, promotion rules per REQ-005 (Integer+Decimal->Decimal, any+Float->Float, Integer/Integer->Decimal for division). Implement variadic semantics per CON-002 (identity elements, left-fold, unary negation/reciprocal). Implement ArithConstraint::eval(&self, subst: &mut Substitution) -> Result<(), ArithError>.
